about_the_game: Cuisine Master is a Virtual Reality cooking game. Players are put in a high-end restaurant where they have to prepare and serve dishes from around the world. There will be 5 main cuisines each with their own difficulty. The cuisines are French, Italian, Middle Eastern, Mexican, and Chinese. Each one will have 1 or more dishes which will either be available at the start of the game or will need to be unlocked from the shop. The shop will be accessible when the level finishes and cannot be accessed while the level is ongoing. There will be different actions that the player must go through in order to complete a dish, and that includes cooking ingredients and cutting some of them on a cutting board. Players will also be required to order their ingredients beforehand and manage their resources, so they do not run out of ingredients in the middle of service.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus Touch
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • VR Support: Oculus Touch
